headlines.title: LangChain raises $300m at a $3bn valuation to help companies run AI agents
Google’s AdMob lets AI agents like Claude Code set up app ads
Stanford professors’ AI lab Noeri launches with $110m, backed by Nvidia
Noeri, which is developing AI software to review and suggest improvements for its clients' AI models and tools, raised $110M led by Menlo Ventures (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
OpenAI says it signed agreements with independent assessors Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire for its first phase of AI model embedded assessments (OpenAI)
Exclusive: Italian robotics startup Mosaico raises €7.5m to tackle AI’s data problem
Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
California AG Rob Bonta sues OpenAI over the Hugging Face incident, alleging OpenAI endangered the public by testing its models without adequate safeguards (Politico)
Former UW AI researchers Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin raise $110M for AI startup Noeri
Anthropic cuts its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, in response to AI-driven bug discovery (Anthropic)
California sues OpenAI over rogue AI hacking incidents
The Apple Watch Series 12 is cheaper than ever ahead of Black Friday
Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI interactions
Q&A with Satya Nadella on code verification becoming more important as code generation gets cheap, Microsoft's voluntary exit offers, decision models, and more (Gergely Orosz/The Pragmatic Engineer)
US moves to cut China’s remote access to AI chips
OpenAI lets Apollo embed six AI safety testers during training
US curbs China’s remote access to AI chips through overseas data centres
Source: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO and it is focused on a national security investigation into Huang (CNBC)
In The AI Era, Keep Hiring New College Grads — And Make Them Managers From Day One
VC Firm Plural Closes On $1.1B To Invest In European Startups With Potential For ‘GDP-Level Impact’
Plural raises fresh €1bn fund to back ‘non-obvious companies’
‘Build what can’t be cloned’: Fintech’s AI-native back office is getting crowded
Amazon loses 40 Leo satellites in ULA Vulcan launch failure — a new setback for its Starlink rival
Starling founder Anne Boden plots new AI-powered bank
